messages:
jess_sales: Quick check — Acme POC ends tomorrow. Do we have a verified teardown checklist for Hosted API keys + Dedicated pool eviction?

jess_sales: They asked for confirmation that ephemeral keys are revoked and any KV cache cleared.

tariq_eng: Yep. Plan is: 1) disable API keys, 2) revoke active tokens, 3) dealloc dedicated GPU pool, 4) confirm KV cache purge, 5) export minimal audit log to customer.

alex_k: For step 2 I can run the revoke script. Heads up: there are ~8 active short-lived keys created during the trial. I scripted a safe revoke that marks keys as revoked then rotates the proxy cert.

maria_s: Can you paste the revoke snippet? Need to pass to Acme security so they can validate we didn’t leave any backdoors.

alex_k: Sure — here’s the command I use on staging (will run in prod after approval):

```
# revoke keys created in last 30 days tagged poc:acme
python tools/revoke_keys.py --tag poc:acme --dry-run
# then without --dry-run after review
```

alex_k: Also rotate the ephemeral proxy creds: `infra rotate-proxy --env poc-acme --ttl 1h`

jess_sales: @legal_team can you confirm if the exported audit bundle (S3 link) needs a special consent form before handing off to the customer?

legal_team: We need a minimal DPA extract for logs containing any PII. If there is no PII, standard export is fine. Please redact any user prompt content first.

tariq_eng: Good call. We'll run the prompt-content scrubber before export. It's the same flow we used for Atlas POC.

maria_s: About Dedicated pool dealloc — is that a hard delete or a soft retire (for rollback)? Customer asked for a 7-day hold window before full deletion.

alex_k: We can do a soft retire: set pool state=retiring, revoke new jobs, drain existing jobs, snapshot current node mapping, then a final delete after 7d. Command: `infra pool retire --pool acme-poc-1 --hold 7d`

jess_sales: Perfect. Add that to the handback email. Also they want confirmation that model weights were not cached off-cluster. Any note?

tariq_eng: No weights were copied. Only runtime KV and shard-index metadata lived in-managed cache. We'll include a statement: "No model weights copied to customer environment or external storage."

maria_s: For data retention, Acme wants logs for 30 days. We keep internal token-level traces for 7 days by default. Do we grant them a 30-day bundle request?

legal_team: We can produce a 30-day export if they sign the DPA extract. Otherwise adhere to default retention.

jess_sales: Ok — action items: 1) @alex_k run revoke & rotate tomorrow morning, 2) @tariq_eng kick pool retire with 7d hold, 3) @maria_s run scrubber + prepare export, 4) @legal_team confirm DPA extract text. I'll send acme the tentative schedule.

infra-bot: Deploy job queued: `revoke-keys-acme` scheduled at 2026-03-23T09:00Z — status: pending.

alex_k: I’ll do a dry-run now and share logs.

maria_s: I'll prep the scrub report and paste sample redaction summary in this thread.

jess_sales: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks tomorrow ping me in DMs and I’ll escalate. :thumbsup:
